text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending that stopping be prohibited on the south side of Riverdale Avenue, between a point 30 metres east of Pape Avenue and a point 14 metres further east. This recommendation is to ensure clear sightlines for motorists exiting the laneway east of Pape Avenue, south of Riverdale Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its January 8, 2020 meeting.
